sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: How are you doing today?
ParticipantB: I'm doing well, thank you. How about you?
ParticipantA: I'm doing pretty good too. So, what kind of pets do you have?
ParticipantB: I have a dog.
ParticipantA: Oh, that's great! What kind of dog do you have?
ParticipantB: I have a golden retriever.
ParticipantA: I love golden retrievers! I have one too.
ParticipantB: That's great! What's your dog's name?
ParticipantA: Her name is Bella.
ParticipantB: That's a beautiful name. What kind of other pets do you have?
ParticipantA: I don't have any other pets, just Bella.
ParticipantB: That's too bad. I have three cats.
ParticipantA: Oh, that's great! I'm actually allergic to cats, so I can't have any.
ParticipantB: I'm sorry to hear that. What kind of other pets do you have then?
ParticipantA: I don't have any other pets, just Bella.
ParticipantB: That's too bad. I love all animals. What kind of other animals do you like?
ParticipantA: I like all animals too, but I'm mostly a dog person.
ParticipantB: I can understand that. I love dogs too, but I also have a soft spot for cats.
ParticipantA: Yeah, cats are great too. What's your dog's name?
ParticipantB: His name is Max.
ParticipantA: That's a great name. Does Max like to play fetch?
ParticipantB: Oh, yes! He loves to play fetch and go for walks.
ParticipantA: That's great! Bella loves to play fetch too.
ParticipantB: That's great! Do you have any funny stories about Bella?
ParticipantA: Well, she likes to steal my socks and run around with them in her mouth.
ParticipantB: That's too funny! My Max does the same thing with my shoes.
ParticipantA: Haha, it's amazing how dogs can be so playful. What do you like to do in your free time?
ParticipantB: I like to read books and watch movies.
ParticipantA: That's great! I like to read books too and watch sports.
ParticipantB: Oh, I don't really watch sports, but I do enjoy reading books.
ParticipantA: Yeah, books are great. Do you have any favorite books or authors?
ParticipantB: I love Jane Austen books. Have you read any of her books?
ParticipantA: Yes, I've read Pride and Prejudice. It's a great book.
ParticipantB: Oh, I love that book too. It's one of my favorites.
ParticipantA: Yeah, it's a classic. What's your favorite Jane Austen book?
ParticipantB: My favorite is probably Sense and Sensibility.
ParticipantA: That's a great book too. I haven't read that one yet, but I will have to check it out.
ParticipantB: Yes, you should definitely read it. It's a great book.
ParticipantA: Okay, I will have to do that. Well, it was nice talking to you.
ParticipantB: Yes, it was great talking to you too.
